description: This line plot illustrates the training loss evolution over iterations for three different configurations of the SepLLM model. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration", spans from 95,000 to 125,000 iterations with a linear scale and tick marks at regular intervals of 5,000 iterations. The y-axis, labeled "Loss", ranges from 2.0 to 3.0 on a linear scale. The plot displays three lines: a magenta solid line with circular markers representing "SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)", which starts at a loss of approximately 3.0 and decreases to about 2.2; a blue solid line with circular markers for "SepLLM (n=128)", which begins at approximately 3.0 and declines to around 2.3; and an orange solid line with circular markers for "SepLLM (n=64)", which also starts near 3.0 and ends at approximately 2.3. A red dashed horizontal line is present at a constant loss value of 2.4, serving as a reference. All three loss curves exhibit a general downward trend, indicating decreasing loss over training iterations.
